Agente com objetivo do tipo \"feche o má: An agent with a goal like "close as many as possible" is already a warning sign: there is no limit.
Prometer prazo, dar preço ou desconto fo: Promise a deadline, give a price or discount outside the price list, make up information that is not in the data, follow orders pasted into the customer's text.
Cada ação com dinheiro ou dado precisa d: Every action involving money or data needs a cap or a human approval.
Mensagens curtas, tom humano, sem parágr: Short messages, human tone, no long paragraphs. And say it is an AI when asked.
A frase exata quando ele não sabe, e a f: The exact phrase for when it doesn't know, and the exact phrase for handing off to a person. This is what prevents embarrassment in front of the customer.
Teste com perguntas que ele não deveria: Test it with questions it shouldn't be able to answer: if it makes something up, tighten the rule before showing it to any customer.
Responde as cinco dúvidas mais comuns? A: Does it answer the five most common questions? Does it admit when it doesn't know? Does the lead alert reach the right person? Does it work on a phone? Does the model's usage account have a balance?
